# Rialto Design System — AI Reference

> Package: `rialto@0.1.0`
> Peer deps: `react`, `react-dom`, `framer-motion`
> Import: `import { Button, Input, ... } from "rialto"`
> CSS: `import "rialto/tokens"` (loads design tokens)
> Showcase: https://mattbutlerengineering.github.io/rialto/

---

## Component Catalog

### Form Inputs

| Component        | Description                              | Key Props                                      |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Input            | Single-line text field with label/hint   | `label`, `hint`, `error`, `type`               |
| TextArea         | Multi-line text with optional auto-grow  | `label`, `rows`, `autoResize`, `maxLength`     |
| NumberInput      | Numeric value with stepper buttons       | `label`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `size`          |
| Checkbox         | Multi-select checkbox                    | `label`, `checked`, `indeterminate`            |
| Radio            | Single radio option (use inside RadioGroup) | `value`, `label`                            |
| RadioGroup       | Single-select from visible options       | `label`, `value`, `onChange`                   |
| Toggle           | Binary on/off switch                     | `label`, `checked`, `disabled`                 |
| Select           | Dropdown for one choice from a list      | `label`, `options`, `placeholder`              |
| SegmentedControl | Pill-style mutually exclusive toggle     | `segments`, `value`, `onChange`, `size`         |
| Slider           | Continuous value range selector          | `min`, `max`, `step`, `value`, `onChange`       |
| PinInput         | Fixed-length code entry (OTP, PINs)      | `label`, `length`, `mask`, `type`              |

### Navigation

| Component      | Description                       | Key Props                              |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Button         | Action trigger with press physics | `variant`, `size`, `disabled`          |
| Breadcrumb     | Navigation trail                  | `items`, `maxItems`                    |
| Tabs           | Switch between content panels     | `tabs`, `activeId`                     |
| Steps          | Multi-step progress indicator     | `steps`, `currentStep`, `orientation`  |
| Pagination     | Page-by-page navigation           | `page`, `totalPages`, `onChange`        |
| NavigationMenu | Horizontal nav with dropdowns     | `items`                                |
| Sidebar        | Vertical app navigation           | `items`, `collapsed`, `onCollapse`     |
| Navbar         | Top navigation bar with logo/user | `links`, `logo`, `user`, `search`      |

### Data Display

| Component | Description                        | Key Props                                     |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| Card      | Content container with surfaces    | `variant`, `title`, `subtitle`                |
| Table     | Generic `<Table<T>>` with sorting  | `columns`, `data`, `rowKey`, `striped`         |
| Badge     | Small status indicator             | `variant`, `size`, `dot`                       |
| Tag       | Selectable/dismissible label       | `variant`, `selected`, `dismissible`           |
| AnimatedTag | Tag with enter/exit animation    | same as Tag                                    |
| TagGroup  | Layout wrapper for multiple Tags   | `children`                                     |
| Avatar    | User image with fallback initials  | `src`, `name`, `size`, `status`                |
| AvatarGroup | Stacked avatars with overflow    | `avatars`, `max`                               |
| Stat      | Metric display with trend          | `value`, `label`, `delta`, `trend`, `size`     |
| DataList  | Key-value pairs                    | `items`, `orientation`, `striped`              |
| Meter     | Gauge for bounded values           | `value`, `min`, `max`, `label`, `variant`      |
| Timeline  | Chronological event sequence       | `items`                                        |
| Tree      | Recursive expandable hierarchy     | `data`, `defaultExpanded`, `selectedId`        |

### Layout & Typography

| Component   | Description                        | Key Props                               |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Stack       | Flexbox layout helper              | `direction`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`  |
| Text        | Typography with semantic variants  | `variant`, `color`, `align`, `as`       |
| Divider     | Visual separator line              | `label`, `spacing`                      |
| Collapsible | Single expand/collapse section     | `open`, `onOpenChange`, `label`         |
| Accordion   | Grouped collapsible panels         | `items`, `allowMultiple`                |
| AspectRatio | Responsive proportional container  | `ratio`                                 |
| ScrollArea  | Custom-styled scroll container     | `width`, `height`                       |
| Kbd         | Keyboard key display               | `children`                              |

### Feedback

| Component     | Description                        | Key Props                                  |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Toast         | Transient notification (Provider!) | See Toast pattern below                    |
| Alert         | Inline contextual message          | `variant`, `title`, `dismissible`          |
| Banner        | Full-width page-level message      | `variant`, `title`, `action`, `dismissible`|
| Progress      | Determinate/indeterminate bar      | `value`, `max`, `indeterminate`, `variant` |
| Spinner       | Loading indicator (unknown duration)| `size`, `label`                           |
| Skeleton      | Loading content placeholder        | `variant`, `width`, `height`               |
| SkeletonGroup | Groups multiple skeletons          | `children`                                 |
| EmptyState    | No-content display with CTA        | `title`, `description`, `action`, `icon`   |

### Overlays

| Component      | Description                       | Key Props                                  |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Dialog         | Modal dialog with focus trap      | `open`, `onClose`, `title`                 |
| ConfirmDialog  | Pre-built confirmation modal      | `open`, `onConfirm`, `onCancel`, `title`, `variant` |
| Drawer         | Slide-out edge panel              | `open`, `onClose`, `title`, `side`, `size` |
| Popover        | Positioned floating content       | `trigger`, `children`, `placement`, `title` |
| Tooltip        | Short hover text                  | `content`, `placement`, `delay`            |
| HoverCard      | Rich hover preview                | `content`                                  |
| CommandPalette | Keyboard command interface (Cmd+K)| `open`, `onOpenChange`, `items`            |
| DropdownMenu   | Action menu triggered by click    | `trigger`, `items`, `align`                |
| ContextMenu    | Right-click action menu           | `items`                                    |

---

## Component Selection Guide

> **Full decision tree**: See `docs/quick-reference/master-decision-tree.md` for a unified guide covering all components by use case, including cross-cutting patterns for loading, errors, and search flows.

### Which form input?

| Need                        | Use                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Single text value           | Input                          |
| Multi-line text             | TextArea                       |
| Number with +/- controls    | NumberInput                    |
| One choice (2–5 options)    | RadioGroup or SegmentedControl |
| One choice (5+ options)     | Select                         |
| Multiple choices            | Checkbox                       |
| On/off toggle               | Toggle                         |
| Fixed-length code entry     | PinInput                       |
| Continuous range            | Slider                         |

### Which overlay?

| Need                  | Use            |
| --------------------- | -------------- |
| Form in a modal       | Dialog         |
| Yes/no confirmation   | ConfirmDialog  |
| Settings/detail panel | Drawer         |
| Positioned content    | Popover        |
| Short help text       | Tooltip        |
| Rich preview on hover | HoverCard      |
| Quick actions (Cmd+K) | CommandPalette |
| Click-triggered menu  | DropdownMenu   |
| Right-click menu      | ContextMenu    |

### Which feedback?

| Need                    | Use        |
| ----------------------- | ---------- |
| Temporary notification  | Toast      |
| Inline message          | Alert      |
| Page-wide message       | Banner     |
| Known progress          | Progress   |
| Unknown loading         | Spinner    |
| Content placeholder     | Skeleton   |
| Nothing to show         | EmptyState |

### Which feedback priority?

Route by urgency — stop at the first match:

| Priority | Condition                    | Component       |
| -------- | ---------------------------- | --------------- |
| P1       | Destructive / irreversible   | ConfirmDialog   |
| P2       | Must act before continuing   | Dialog / Drawer |
| P3       | Page-wide notice             | Banner          |
| P4       | Tied to a specific element   | Alert           |
| P5       | Brief notification           | Toast           |
| P6       | Supplemental hover info      | Tooltip / HoverCard |

> Full routing matrix with comparison table: `docs/quick-reference/feedback-routing.md`

### Which navigation?

| Need               | Use              |
| ------------------ | ---------------- |
| Switch panels      | Tabs             |
| Path trail         | Breadcrumb       |
| Wizard/step flow   | Steps            |
| Paginated content  | Pagination       |
| View mode toggle   | SegmentedControl |
| Top-bar dropdowns  | NavigationMenu   |
| App sidebar        | Sidebar          |
| Top nav bar        | Navbar           |

---

## Token Quick Reference

### Surfaces

| Token                        | Value     | When to use                              |
| ---------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `--rialto-surface`           | `#f8f6f3` | Page backgrounds, default component bg   |
| `--rialto-surface-elevated`  | `#fdfcfa` | Cards, popovers, elevated containers     |
| `--rialto-surface-recessed`  | `#edeae5` | Input fields, slider tracks, channels    |
| `--rialto-surface-matte`     | `#d8d4cd` | Disabled fills, subtle divider bg        |
| `--rialto-surface-deep`      | `#a8a49d` | Heavy separators, decorative accents     |

### Text

| Token                      | Value     | When to use                            |
| -------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `--rialto-text-primary`    | `#1a1918` | Headings, body text, primary labels    |
| `--rialto-text-secondary`  | `#6b6660` | Descriptions, helper text              |
| `--rialto-text-tertiary`   | `#9e9890` | Placeholders, disabled, timestamps     |
| `--rialto-text-on-accent`  | `#fdfcfa` | Text on accent-filled backgrounds      |

### Borders

| Token                    | Value     | When to use                          |
| ------------------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `--rialto-border`        | `#d8d4cd` | Default borders (cards, inputs)      |
| `--rialto-border-strong` | `#b8b4ad` | Emphasized borders, active outlines  |

### Accent (gold — surgical use only)

| Token                    | Value                      | When to use                          |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `--rialto-accent`        | `#c4922a`                  | Primary buttons, focus rings, active |
| `--rialto-accent-hover`  | `#d4a23a`                  | Primary button hover                 |
| `--rialto-accent-muted`  | `rgb(196 146 42 / 0.12)`  | Selected rows, active tab bg         |
| `--rialto-accent-glow`   | `rgb(196 146 42 / 0.35)`  | Focus ring outer glow                |

### Semantic

| Token                    | Value                      | When to use                     |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `--rialto-error`         | `#b84a3c`                  | Error text, destructive actions |
| `--rialto-error-muted`   | `rgb(184 74 60 / 0.1)`    | Error alert/badge backgrounds   |
| `--rialto-success`       | `#7a8a3c`                  | Success text, confirmation      |
| `--rialto-success-muted` | `rgb(122 138 60 / 0.1)`   | Success alert/badge backgrounds |

### Shadows

| Token                      | When to use                                    |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `--rialto-shadow-elevated` | Cards, dropdowns, popovers                     |
| `--rialto-shadow-pressed`  | Recessed inputs, slider tracks, active press   |
| `--rialto-shadow-focus`    | Focus-visible ring on all interactive elements |
| `--rialto-shadow-glass`    | Floating glass panels, command palette         |

### Radius (hierarchy-based)

| Token                    | Value    | When to use                       |
| ------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `--rialto-radius-none`   | `0`      | No rounding                       |
| `--rialto-radius-sharp`  | `2px`    | Chips, badges, small elements     |
| `--rialto-radius-default`| `6px`    | Buttons, inputs, interactive      |
| `--rialto-radius-soft`   | `10px`   | Cards, dialogs, containers        |
| `--rialto-radius-round`  | `9999px` | Pills, avatars, full-round        |

### Spacing (4px base)

| Token                 | Value  | When to use                          |
| --------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `--rialto-space-2xs`  | `4px`  | Icon padding, tight chip internals   |
| `--rialto-space-xs`   | `8px`  | Badge padding, tight gaps            |
| `--rialto-space-sm`   | `12px` | Button padding, input spacing        |
| `--rialto-space-md`   | `16px` | Default component padding            |
| `--rialto-space-lg`   | `24px` | Card padding, form gaps              |
| `--rialto-space-xl`   | `32px` | Between card groups, dialog body     |
| `--rialto-space-2xl`  | `48px` | Section spacing                      |
| `--rialto-space-3xl`  | `64px` | Major page sections                  |
| `--rialto-space-4xl`  | `96px` | Hero spacing, full-page gaps         |

---

## Motion Reference

Import from `"rialto/tokens/motion"` (or `src/tokens/motion.ts`).

| Preset         | Type      | When to use                                          |
| -------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `precision`    | Duration  | Standard UI transitions, hover, small movements      |
| `spring`       | Spring    | Toggles, sliders, detent-feel interactions           |
| `springGentle` | Spring    | Dialogs, drawers, card expansions, larger movements  |
| `reduced`      | Duration  | Fallback when `useReducedMotion()` returns true      |

Always check `useReducedMotion()` from Framer Motion and skip animation when true.

---

## Character Limits

Maximum character counts per prop to prevent AI-generated content from breaking layouts. Full list in `dist/manifest.json` under `characterLimits`.

### Short (≤30 chars) — single-line labels

| Component        | Prop              | Max |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | --- |
| Badge            | children          | 20  |
| Kbd              | children          | 10  |
| Tag              | children          | 30  |
| Button           | children          | 30  |
| Tabs             | tabs[].label      | 20  |
| Breadcrumb       | items[].label     | 25  |
| SegmentedControl | segments[].label  | 15  |
| Stat             | label / value     | 25 / 15 |
| Toggle / Checkbox / Radio | label   | 30  |

### Medium (31–120 chars) — titles, hints, descriptions

| Component        | Prop              | Max |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | --- |
| Input / Select   | label             | 40  |
| Input            | hint / error      | 80  |
| Toast            | title / description | 50 / 120 |
| Alert / Banner   | title             | 60  |
| Dialog / Drawer  | title             | 60  |
| Card             | title / subtitle  | 60 / 80 |
| Tooltip          | content           | 80  |

### Long (121–500 chars) — body content

| Component  | Prop        | Max |
| ---------- | ----------- | --- |
| Alert      | children    | 500 |
| EmptyState | description | 300 |
| Timeline   | items[].description | 200 |

**Unrestricted**: Dialog.Body, Drawer content, HoverCard content, Card children (ReactNode slots).

---

## Icon Vocabulary

Rialto maps UI concepts to [Lucide React](https://lucide.dev) icons. Every concept has exactly one canonical icon — use these instead of choosing ad-hoc.

### Usage

```tsx
// Direct import (tree-shakes to just the icons you use)
import { Save, Trash2, Plus } from "lucide-react";
<Button><Save size={16} /> Save</Button>

// Lookup by concept name (useful for dynamic/data-driven UIs)
import { getIcon } from "rialto";
const Icon = getIcon("save"); // → Save component
if (Icon) <Icon size={16} />;
```

### Sizing conventions

| Context            | Size  |
| ------------------ | ----- |
| Small buttons (sm) | 14px  |
| Medium buttons     | 16px  |
| Standalone icons   | 20px  |
| Hero / empty state | 32–48px |

### Concept → Icon mapping

| Category | concept → Lucide |
|----------|-----------------|
| navigation | `home`→Home, `back`→ArrowLeft, `forward`→ArrowRight, `menu`→Menu, `search`→Search, `external-link`→ExternalLink, `expand`→ChevronDown, `collapse`→ChevronRight, `more-actions`→MoreHorizontal |
| actions | `save`→Save, `delete`→Trash2, `edit`→SquarePen, `add`→Plus, `copy`→Copy, `share`→Share, `download`→Download, `upload`→Upload, `refresh`→RefreshCw, `undo`→Undo, `redo`→Redo |
| communication | `email`→Mail, `message`→MessageCircle, `notification`→Bell, `send`→Send, `phone`→Phone |
| status | `success`→CircleCheck, `error`→CircleX, `warning`→AlertTriangle, `info`→Info, `loading`→Loader |
| content | `file`→File, `file-text`→FileText, `folder`→Folder, `folder-open`→FolderOpen, `image`→Image, `link`→Link2, `clipboard`→Clipboard |
| user | `user`→User, `users`→Users, `user-add`→UserPlus, `settings`→Settings, `logout`→LogOut |
| data | `filter`→Filter, `sort`→ArrowUpDown, `chart`→BarChart3, `trending-up`→TrendingUp, `trending-down`→TrendingDown, `checklist`→ListChecks |
| media | `play`→Play, `pause`→Pause, `camera`→Camera, `video`→Video |
| commerce | `cart`→ShoppingCart, `credit-card`→CreditCard, `dollar`→DollarSign, `package`→Package, `tag`→Tag |

### Helpers

| Export | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| `iconVocabulary` | Full `readonly IconEntry[]` array (57 entries) |
| `getIcon(concept)` | Returns `LucideIcon \| undefined` for a concept string |
| `getIconsByCategory(cat)` | Returns `readonly IconEntry[]` filtered by category |
| `iconCategories` | Ordered `readonly IconCategory[]` (9 categories) |

---

## Composition Patterns

### Login form

```tsx
<Card title="Sign in">
  <Stack direction="column" gap="md">
    <Input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
    <Input label="Password" type="password" />
    <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center" justify="between">
      <Checkbox label="Remember me" />
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Forgot password?</Button>
    </Stack>
    <Button variant="primary">Sign in</Button>
  </Stack>
</Card>
```

### Settings panel

```tsx
<Drawer open={isOpen} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Settings" side="right">
  <Stack direction="column" gap="lg">
    <Toggle label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onCheckedChange={setDark} />
    <Toggle label="Notifications" checked={notifs} onCheckedChange={setNotifs} />
    <Divider />
    <Select
      label="Language"
      options={[
        { value: "en", label: "English" },
        { value: "fr", label: "French" },
      ]}
    />
    <Divider />
    <Button variant="primary">Save changes</Button>
  </Stack>
</Drawer>
```

### Confirmation flow

```tsx
<ConfirmDialog
  open={showConfirm}
  onConfirm={handleConfirm}
  onCancel={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
  title="Delete project?"
  description="This action cannot be undone. All data will be permanently removed."
  confirmLabel="Delete"
  variant="destructive"
/>
```

### Data table page

```tsx
<Stack direction="column" gap="lg">
  <Table
    columns={[
      { key: "name", header: "Name", sortable: true },
      { key: "role", header: "Role" },
      { key: "status", header: "Status", render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={row.active ? "success" : "neutral"}>
          {row.active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
        </Badge>
      )},
    ]}
    data={users}
    rowKey={(u) => u.id}
    striped
    emptyMessage="No users found"
  />
  <Pagination page={page} totalPages={totalPages} onChange={setPage} />
</Stack>
```

### Toast notifications

```tsx
// 1. Wrap your app with the provider (once, at the root):
<ToastProvider>
  <App />
</ToastProvider>

// 2. Use the hook anywhere inside the provider:
function SaveButton() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  return (
    <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Saved!", variant: "success" })}>
      Save
    </Button>
  );
}
```

---

## Common Mistakes

**Do:**
- Use `var(--rialto-*)` tokens for all colors, spacing, and radii
- Use gold accent (`--rialto-accent`) only for focus rings, active/selected states, primary buttons
- Use Framer Motion for interactive animations
- Check `useReducedMotion()` before animating
- Wrap app with `<ToastProvider>` before using `useToast()`
- Import from `"rialto"` (barrel export)

**Don't:**
- Hardcode color values — always use tokens
- Use gold accent for decorative purposes, backgrounds, or body text
- Use CSS transitions for interactive animations (use Framer Motion)
- Use `--luce-*` prefix — the correct prefix is `--rialto-*`
- Import from subpaths like `"rialto/components/Button"` — use the barrel
- Call `useToast()` without a `<ToastProvider>` ancestor
- Skip `forwardRef` when authoring new components
- Use more than 3 font weights (300, 400, 500)
- Call `useUIEnvironment()` without a `<RialtoProvider>` ancestor

---

## Adaptive UI Environment

### RialtoProvider

Wraps your app to provide device context, theming, and vibe token overrides.

```tsx
import { RialtoProvider } from "rialto";

<RialtoProvider vibe="transacting" theme="dark">
  <App />
</RialtoProvider>
```

| Prop           | Type                              | Default     | Description                                    |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| vibe           | `"default" \| "transacting" \| "presenting"` | `"default"` | Vibe preset that adjusts spacing/radius/weight |
| vibeOverrides  | `Record<string, string>`          | —           | Additional CSS custom property overrides        |
| theme          | `"light" \| "dark" \| "system"`   | `"system"`  | Theme mode. `"system"` follows OS preference   |

### Vibes

Vibes shift CSS custom properties on a container div — child components adapt automatically via the CSS cascade (zero runtime cost for children).

- **default** — no overrides, standard Rialto tokens
- **transacting** — tighter spacing, sharper radii, bolder weight for urgency (checkout, payments)
- **presenting** — more whitespace, larger type, softer radii for presentation (dashboards, demos)

### useDeviceContext

Standalone hook (no provider needed) detecting device environment via `matchMedia`:

```tsx
import { useDeviceContext } from "rialto";

const { pointer, viewport, reducedMotion, colorScheme, saveData } = useDeviceContext();
```

Returns: `{ pointer: "fine" | "coarse", viewport: "mobile" | "tablet" | "desktop", reducedMotion: boolean, colorScheme: "light" | "dark", saveData: boolean }`

### useUIEnvironment

Consumer hook providing device context, active vibe, and resolved theme. Requires `<RialtoProvider>`.

```tsx
import { useUIEnvironment } from "rialto";

const { device, vibe, theme } = useUIEnvironment();
```

### Component Manifest

Run `pnpm manifest` (from packages/rialto) to generate `dist/manifest.json` — a build-time metadata file listing all components, their props (with types, descriptions, defaults), and slots. Use this to guide LLM code generation.

---

## Development

### Commands

| Command                      | Description                                 |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`                   | Start Vite dev server                       |
| `pnpm test`                  | Run 144 unit tests (Vitest)                 |
| `pnpm test:visual`           | Run 41 visual regression tests (Playwright) |
| `pnpm test:visual:update`    | Regenerate baseline screenshots             |
| `pnpm build`                 | Build library then showcase                 |
| `pnpm build:lib`             | Build library for publishing                |
| `pnpm lint`                  | ESLint with accessibility rules             |
| `pnpm size`                  | Check bundle sizes                          |

### Visual Test Harness

The `/visual-test` route in the showcase app renders 30+ components in static, deterministic states for screenshot comparison. Each section has a `data-testid` attribute used by Playwright to locate and screenshot it.

- Baselines live in `e2e/screenshots/` (committed to git)
- Tests run in `e2e/visual.spec.ts` using `toHaveScreenshot()`
- Reduced motion is forced before navigation to prevent animation flicker
- Baselines must be generated on Linux to match CI (use Docker or the CI itself)
